snippet.title: All Rats on Deck - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
All Rats on Deck is a co-op steamboat adventure for up to four players.

Forced from your home, you and your rat buddies must navigate dangerous waters, scavenge whatever you can find, keep your scrappy boat running, and work together to reach the ocean. Feed the engine, fire the grapple gun, survive the rapids, and try not to blow up the boat along the way.

Wishlist All Rats on Deck on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4536480/All_Rats_on_Deck/

Join our discord: 
https://discord.gg/bE8ENCy5wZ

Published by Loopr Partners.
